title: PMCR-O Queue Item (one file under .pmcro/queue/)
$comment: Trail-as-Product applies to queue items too: every file under .pmcro/queue/ is an instance of this schema, not hand-typed prose. Filed by reflect-and-seed when a Reflection's next_seed is non-null, or by a human/seed-intent capture flow outside this plugin. The file's basename (minus .json) equals 'id'. No absolute, host-specific, or drive-letter paths in any field.

proposed_role.description: Which role's phase the seed is expected to start at once claimed — usually 'maker', occasionally 'planner' for larger re-plans.

source_trail_id.description: The sealed trail whose Reflection proposed this seed, or null for a seed filed outside a cycle (e.g. direct human intent capture).

status.description: 'claimed' is set by whichever future Orchestrator opens a cycle for this seed; this plugin only ever writes 'open'.
